verdict.rationale: Bun's docs extensively cover workspaces (monorepo support, single bun.lock lockfile, --filter for cross-package operations, catalogs for shared versions, hoisting barriers, and lockfile migration from other tools), directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates real-world monorepo use and calls out reliability improvements (isolated installs) though some report install bugs/crashes in monorepo setups. Missing for 10: independent large-scale monorepo case studies and resolution of the community-reported install crash bugs.
